episodes.title: Moonlit Plains
episodes.summary: From the African savanna to the Peruvian desert, lives of predators and prey are closely linked to the moon's cycles and the opportunities they bring.

episodes.title: Frozen Nights
episodes.summary: Mothers with cubs fight to survive, and a lonely monkey finds safety in numbers as animals navigate cold landscapes during the planet's longest nights.

episodes.title: Jungle Nights
episodes.summary: Beneath the jungle's canopy, the night is alive with fantastic beasts, large and small, who use the darkness to socialize, hunt, climb and crawl.

episodes.title: Dark Seas
episodes.summary: The oceans' tides ebb and flow in concert with the moon, and so do the lives of the creatures below, from the largest whale shark to the smallest prawn.

episodes.title: Sleepless Cities
episodes.summary: After dark, the natural world appears in unnatural places: Migrating elephants stroll through town, and urbanized otters romp in the city.

episodes.title: Dusk Till Dawn
episodes.summary: The night unfolds to reveal magic in the air, drama in the deep, and danger on the ground as animals across the planet rise with the sunset.
